entities.summary: Amanda Jane Levete is a British architect and the principal of AL_A. While she worked as a partner at Future Systems, the company was awarded the 1999 Stirling Prize for their work on the Lord's Media Centre. She has also received several prizes and accolades for her work at AL_A.
